title: GTAO compute dispatch crashes silently on DX12 — needs RenderDoc diagnosis
content: GTAOPass compiles and creates pipelines successfully, but the first Execute() call causes a silent process crash with no D3D12 validation error and no DRED breadcrumb. The crash occurs after "GTAOPass: denoise pipeline created" log with nothing else printed. Likely causes: root constant buffer overflow (GTAORootConstants struct may exceed 16 DWORD limit), UAV binding mismatch (depth/normal SRV may conflict with AO UAV), or descriptor heap corruption. Must use RenderDoc capture + PIX GPU capture to diagnose — cannot be solved by code analysis alone.
